description: getLatestCorrectionsForJd returns the newest correction for roleIndex across runs
getLatestCorrectionsForJd ignores runs with status 'success' (only 'corrected' and 'accepted')
getFeedbackStats on empty database returns all 0 counts, avgReward null, dpoReady false
getFeedbackStats returns accurate aggregates and averages rewards strictly where rewardScore < 0.999
getFeedbackStats sets dpoReady true when preferencePairs >= 50
DPO export orders by createdAt asc, formats prompt with chunkContent or fallback rawJdText, and appends trailing newline
DPO export with 0 pairs produces empty string without trailing newline
